data.title: Le Meow Worker
data.description: A dedicated app for Le Meow service professionals — giving workers everything they need to manage bookings, track jobs, and stay organised on the platform.
highlights: Instant job request notifications with full booking details
Clean dashboard for managing upcoming and active jobs
View customer notes, service requirements, and timing at a glance
Job status updates to stay on top of daily workflow
Simple, intuitive interface for all service types
